Retry 20261114-055838-0d3t and 20261114-112705-q134 ('try again on <job>'). Both failed only because the planner hit its 600 s deadline. athena.toml now sets planner_timeout_s = 86400 (landed in 20261114-184053-050s), but no retry was queued. Two sibling jobs from the same day (aymy, hvyh) were retried. Then make the drain queue a retry, at the original priority, for each failed job whose outcome says 'the planner did not complete: deadline of Ns reached' when the configured planner limit is now above N. Acceptance: a test with a failed planner-deadline job and a raised limit shows one retry queued; with an unchanged limit it shows none; a CHANGELOG.md entry.

Acceptance:
- The change is made as described: Jobs that failed only on the 600 s planner deadline (0d3t, q134) were never retried after the planner limit was raised to 24 h
- No unrelated behavior changes; the existing tests pass
- fmt, clippy and test pass

Files: athena.toml, CHANGELOG.md
